sql: WITH s AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (market_ticker) market_ticker, captured_at, side, quantity, quantity_fp, avg_price FROM positions WHERE captured_at >= date_trunc('day', now()) ORDER BY market_ticker, captured_at DESC) SELECT s.*, (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT o.strategy||':'||o.side||':'||o.action||':'||o.status, ', ') FROM live_orders o WHERE o.market_ticker=s.market_ticker) AS orders FROM s WHERE coalesce(s.quantity_fp, s.quantity) <> 0
